# Runtime dependencies

websocket-client 1.9.2, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/websocket-client/websocket-client.
Pure-Python package from the PyPI wheel; tests, caches and the unused CLI are excluded.
Bundled to keep Lite Python 3.10+ usable without a new host installation step.
Runtime files are unmodified; license is in websocket/LICENSE.
